frozen.uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسٰىهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
frozen.indopak: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسٰىهَا اِنَّ رَبِّىْ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
frozen.clean: بسم الله مجراها ومرسيها ان ربي لغفور رحيم
frozen.transliteration: Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha inna rabbee laGhafoorur-Raheem

source.name: Dua for mounting boat/ship
source.content: Noah (AS) took a boat ride while reading the following prayer:
source.translation: In the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
source.note: Note that, this Dua cannot be said while mounting an animal or any means of transport. However, in our country, this dua is written in front of many vehicles and the supervisor says this dua when starting the journey, which is wrong.

source.name: When out on tour
source.content: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out on a journey, he would sit on the back of his camel and say three times:

source.name: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)
source.content:
Allah says:

Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace.

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ اَللَّهُمَّ اطْوِ لَنَا الْأَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الْاَهْلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَّعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَاٰبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَسُوْءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْاَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اطْوِ لَنَا الْاَرْضَ وَهَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ
frozen.clean: اللهم انت الصاحب في السفر والخليفه في الاهل اللهم اني اعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر وكابه المنقلب وسوء المنظر في الاهل والمال اللهم اطو لنا الارض وهون علينا السفر
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma 'Antas-saahibu fis-safari wal-khaleefatu fil-'ahli, Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safari, wa kaabatil munqalabi wa su'il manzari fil-ahli wal maali, Allaahummatwi lanal-arda wa hawwin alainas-safara

source.name: Dua for traveler #1
source.content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to recite this du'a when he was on a journey:
source.translation: O Allah, You are the Companion in the journey, and the One Who looks after the family; O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the difficulty of travelling, finding harm when I return, and unhappiness in what I see coming to my family and property. O Allah, make the length of his journey short for us, and the journey easy for us.

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِيْ هَذَا مِنَ الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا الْمَسِيرَ وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَ الْأَرْضِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اَللَّهُمَّ اصْحَبْنَا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَاخْلُفْنَا فِي أَهْلِنَا
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ فِيْ سَفَرِيْ هَذَا مِنَ الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوٰى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضٰى، اَللّٰهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا الْمَسِيْرَ وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَ الْاَرْضِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الْاَهْلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْحَبْنَا فِيْ سَفَرِنَا وَاخْلُفْنَا فِيْ اَهْلِنَا
frozen.clean: اللهم اني اسالك في سفري هذا من البر والتقوي ومن العمل ما ترضي اللهم هون علينا المسير واطو عنا بعد الارض اللهم انت الصاحب في السفر والخليفه في الاهل اللهم اصحبنا في سفرنا واخلفنا في اهلنا
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma inni as’aluka fi safari hadha minal-birri wat-taqwa, wa minal-`amali maa tarda. Allaahumma hawwin `alainal-masira, watwi `anna bu`dal-ard. Allaahumma antas-saahibu fis safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahli. Allaahumma ashaabna fi safarina wakhlufna fi ahlina

source.name: Dua for traveler #2
source.content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to recite this du'a when he was on a journey:
source.translation: O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine from the righteousness and piety and actions that which you are pleased with. O Allah, ease for us the path, and make near for us the distance of the land. O Allah, You are the companion in the journey, and the caretaker for the family. O Allah, accompany us in our journey, and take care of our families

frozen.uthmani: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
frozen.indopak: لَبَّيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
frozen.clean: لبيك اللهم لبيك لبيك لا شريك لك لبيك ان الحمد والنعمه لك والملك لا شريك لك
frozen.transliteration: Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, 'innal-hamda, wanni'mata, laka wal mulk, laa shareeka lak.

source.name: Hajj/Umrah - Talbiya
source.translation: I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. I am here at Your service, You have no partener, I am here at Your service. Surely the praise, and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partener.
source.note: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reciting this talbiyyah with his hair tied together. (The Dua is motioned above) He did not utter more words than this.

source.name: Uttering takbir when passing the black stone
source.content: Narrated Ibn `Abbas (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) ending a camel (at that time the Prophet [ﷺ] had foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar."

frozen.uthmani: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
frozen.indopak: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
frozen.clean: ربنا اتنا في الدنيا حسنه وفي الاخره حسنه وقنا عذاب النار
frozen.transliteration: Rabbanaa 'aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-'aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'athaaban-naar

source.name: Between the Yemeni corner and black stone [of Ka'bah]
source.translation: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world and the good things in the next life and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
source.note: Narrated Abdullah Ibn Sa'ib (RA): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recite this prayer in the middle of two rukans. (The dua is Mentioned above)

frozen.uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
frozen.indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
frozen.clean: لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد وهو علي كل شيء قدير
frozen.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer

source.name: The dua at the day of 'Arafah
source.content: Narrated by Amr Ibn Shuaib (RA) from his grandfather through his father, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, “The best dua is the dua on the day of Arafa. The best prayer I and my predecessors have read is -
source.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without any partener. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
source.note: Narrated by Amr Ibn Shuaib (RA) from his grandfather through his father, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, “The best dua is the dua on the day of Arafa. The best prayer I and my predecessors have read is - (The dua is Mentioned above)

[1] The name of the vehicle of the Prophet (ﷺ)

source.name: Sacred Site [al-Mash'ar al-Haraam] - At Muzdalifa
source.content: Narrated Jabir Ibn Abdillah (RA): At one point in his long hadith of the Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ), he said, “Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lay down until dawn. After the morning became clear, he performed the Fajr prayer with one Azan and one Iqamah. Then he came to Al-Mash'arul Haram on a Qaswaa [1].There he turned to the Qibla and supplicated to Allah and proclaimed the superiority, sovereignty and unity of Allah. He stayed there until the morning light became extremely bright. Then he left before the sun rose.' [2]

source.name: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
source.content:
Ibn `Umar (RA) used to do Rami of the Jamrat-ud-Dunya (the Jamra near to the Khaif mosque) with seven small stones and used to recite Takbir on throwing every pebble. He then would go ahead till he reached the level ground where he would stand facing the Qibla for a long time to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands (while invoking). 

Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Wusta (middle Jamra) and then he would go to the left towards the middle ground, where he would stand facing the Qibla. He would remain standing there for a long period to invoke (Allah) while raising his hands, and would stand there for a long period. 

Then he would do Rami of the Jamrat-ul-Aqaba from the middle of the valley, but he would not stay by it, and then he would leave and say, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing like this."

source.name: Takbir when passing the black stone
source.note: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Tawaf (of the Ka`ba) ending a camel (at that time the Prophet [ﷺ] had foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar." (The dua is Mentioned above)

source.name: Sacred Site [al-Mash'ar al-Haraam] - At Muzdalifa
source.content: The Prophet (ﷺ) rode on a camel called 'Kaswa'.When he finally came to Mash'arul Haram (a place in Muzdalifah), he prayed facing the Qibla and said takbeer -

source.name: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
source.content: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say when throwing pebbles in three jamarat:
source.note: Then he would move forward a little and stand facing the Qibla and would do Dua with both hands raised in the first Jamra and the second Jamra. But at the time of throwing every pebble at Jamratul Akbaba, he would say ‘Allahu Akbar’ and return without staying there.

frozen.uthmani: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ
frozen.indopak: اِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰهِ
frozen.clean: ان الصفا والمروه من شعاءر الله
frozen.transliteration: Inna assafa wal-marwata min shaAAa-iri Allah

source.name: Which dua should be read while standing in Safa and Marwa
source.content: When the Prophet (ﷺ) approached mount as-Safaa he would recite:
source.translation: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. [1]
